agents.mission: Own incident state, validate handoffs, route work, and publish evidence-backed status.
agents.handoff_condition: Route only schema-valid artifacts and preserve actor boundaries.

agents.mission: Collect only allowlisted checkpoint, configuration, metric-hash, and run evidence.
agents.handoff_condition: Evidence validates and excluded/immutable data remains unread or unchanged.

agents.mission: Infer bounded checkpoint hypotheses from explicit evidence and gaps.
agents.handoff_condition: Every claim cites evidence_id and carries confidence and falsification criteria.

agents.mission: Turn one evidence-backed hypothesis into a one-variable, budgeted, reversible experiment.
agents.handoff_condition: Plan changes exactly one checkpoint field and defines success, budget, forbidden changes, and rollback.

agents.mission: Apply an approved plan only inside a fresh sandbox and record hashes and outputs.
agents.handoff_condition: Run artifact records changed paths, hashes, command, exit status, and sandbox boundary.

agents.mission: Independently recompute metrics, enforce immutable-file policy, verify trace, and decide closure or rollback.
agents.handoff_condition: PASS requires independent score and unchanged immutable hashes; violations end ROLLED_BACK.
